'''Hatch''' is the innkeeper of [[The Dusty Wheel]].
==Activities==
Hatch keeps a special cudgel for men that look at his wife for too long.{{ref/book|13|31}}
==Trivia==
Hatch is a tribute to Matt Hatch, webmaster at Theoryland.com. Hatch began a live, weekly call-in show on YouTube called ''The Dusty Wheel'', where he often simply refers to himself as The Innkeeper.
